verdict.rationale: ADP's API Central, a separately purchased add-on, documents an API discovery tool, generated code samples, and self-service use-case templates with documentation and code collection samples. That is a first-party way to explore APIs with examples. However, nothing shows an interactive reference where examples can be run in-browser, and the probe found developers.adp.com serves only a client-rendered shell. Missing for 10: an interactive API reference or 'try it' console, examples that are actually runnable, independent or hands-on corroboration, and an explicit tie to RUN-specific APIs.
